teacherNotes.title: Core Words
teacherNotes.content: morning, afternoon, evening, night, dawn, dusk, at, in, on, early, late, everyday

elements.content: Core Active Vocabulary (10-20 items):
morning, afternoon, evening, night, dawn, dusk, at, in, on, early, late, everyday
Essential Chunks & Functional Collocations:

• In the morning I drink coffee (stating morning action)
• I work in the afternoon (stating afternoon routine)
• At night I read a book (stating evening action)
• I wake up early (describing time preference)

teacherNotes.title: Phonetic Focus
teacherNotes.content: Pronunciation of /ɪŋ/ in 'morning', 'evening' and stress in 'afternoon'.

elements.content: Pronunciation Focus:
Pronunciation of /ɪŋ/ in 'morning', 'evening' and stress in 'afternoon'.

teacherNotes.title: Grammar Function
teacherNotes.content: Prepositions of Time ('at 8:00', 'in the morning', 'in the afternoon', 'at night')

elements.content: Grammar System & Functional Framing:
Prepositions of Time ('at 8:00', 'in the morning', 'in the afternoon', 'at night')
Controlled Practice:
You wake up when the sun rises at 6:00 AM. What time of day is it?
Reading Script & Dialogue:

A: What do you do in the morning?
B: I drink tea and read news. What about you?
A: I wake up early at six and go for a walk in the park.
Listening Comprehension:
Listen to three people describing their daily schedule by parts of the day and complete their timelines.

teacherNotes.title: Speaking Aim (~70%)
teacherNotes.content: I can express when activities happen using parts of the day and time prepositions.

elements.content: Communicative Speaking Task:
Practice speaking with your partner: I can express when activities happen using parts of the day and time prepositions.
Writing Task:
Write 3-5 sentences in your notebook applying target phrases from today's lesson.

teacherNotes.title: Multi-Duration Strategy
teacherNotes.content: Choose 60m, 90m, or 120m flow based on scheduled class length.

elements.content: Timestamped Multi-Duration Flows:

• 60m Flow (Essential): 0-10m Warm-up & Goal; 10-25m Vocab & Chunks; 25-40m Grammar Practice; 40-55m Speaking Pair Task; 55-60m Cool-down.
• 90m Flow (Expanded): 0-10m Warm-up; 10-30m 5-step Vocab Drills; 30-50m Grammar Workshop; 50-70m Roleplay; 70-85m Writing; 85-90m Wrap-up.
• 120m Flow (Full Workshop): 0-15m Icebreaker; 15-40m Vocab Lab; 40-70m Grammar Simulation; 70-100m Group Activity; 100-115m Writing Portfolio; 115-120m Reflection.
